title: Location never right when entering mileage manually
content: When I start typing the location where my drive started or ended it will never show me the address. It’s the same address displayed and I have to click on whatever is displayed and it might or might not add the correct address. In today geo mapping apps this sad. As every other app can display the address you start typing and suggest the one based on the start of the typed address you enter . Bad execution for a paid app. Seeking alternative app.
